svg.text: SPEAR — every component of the harness
Dependency direction is strictly downward: nothing below the application band imports rag_chat, and the bottom band imports nothing of the project at all.
Application — the only layer that talks to a human
Orchestration — one task, bounded and synchronous
Runtime core — the model loop and everything that bounds it
Task truth and evidence — what a session leaves behind
Training data as a by-product — operator-only, never model-visible
Read the bands as ownership, not as call order. WorkingState is task truth and changes only through typed grounded events; SessionStore is resumable runtime state; ResultStore owns
large evidence; CheckpointManager owns recovery; MemoryStore owns durable knowledge; ContextEngine is the only production context composer. A module in a lower band never reaches
up: the application constructs, the runtime executes, the substrate confines.
